kind: Exploratory warm work diagnostics; cold parallel-8 campaigns determine benchmark acceptance
comparison_scope: Combined exact-product reuse (round4) and shifted-storage reuse (round5); not an isolated shifted-workspace timing

large_sparse_glm.kind: Exploratory paired same-process solves; not a cold benchmark campaign

validation: All 12 cases pass independent original-data KKT validation with bitwise-identical non-time histories and x/y/s/nu arrays. Unit regressions separately cover sparse-storage equality, zero crossings, noncanonical/dtype fallback, retry shifts, changed inputs, and whole-solve fallback equivalence.
limitations: Warm alternating measurements on CPU11 and CPU12 while other cores ran independent work; these are profiling observations, not standardized campaign timing.
Reference683f4ef precedes round4 commit98250de, so measured speedups include both rounds.
